headline: Two Critical Wasmtime Flaws Could Let Malicious WebAssembly Modules Escape Sandboxes
summary: Two critical flaws in the Wasmtime WebAssembly runtime could allow a malicious module to break out of its sandbox, and fixed versions have been released.
whyItMatters: Sandbox escape could let attackers execute code on vulnerable hosts.
recommendedAction: Update Wasmtime to the patched version immediately.

headline: PHP2Shell security flaws now sucessfully exploited in the wild
summary: Two critical RCE vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619) known as PHP2Shell are being actively exploited in the wild.
whyItMatters: Active exploitation puts vulnerable PHP applications at immediate risk of compromise.
recommendedAction: Patch affected PHP installations and monitor for exploitation attempts.

headline: uCreator Android Spyware Can Steal Telegram 2FA Passwords and Clone WeChat Accounts
summary: The uCreator Android spyware kit hides malicious code in tampered Telegram and WeChat apps to steal 2FA passwords and clone accounts.
whyItMatters: It enables credential theft and unauthorized access to popular messaging platforms.
recommendedAction: Block and remove any tampered app installations and monitor for compromised accounts.

headline: Microsoft 365 Token-Replay Attacks Compromise 97 Accounts at 79 Organizations
summary: A campaign used adversary‑in‑the‑middle token replay to hijack Microsoft 365 sign‑in sessions, compromising 97 accounts across 79 organizations.
whyItMatters: Token replay can give attackers persistent access to corporate email and data.
recommendedAction: Enforce MFA, monitor token usage, and rotate compromised tokens.

headline: Gheist Uses Stolen GitHub Tokens to Steal Private Repository Secrets via Actions Logs
summary: The Gheist campaign steals GitHub tokens, plants workflows that log repository secrets, then extracts and deletes the logs.
whyItMatters: Exfiltrated secrets can lead to further compromise of private code and infrastructure.
recommendedAction: Revoke compromised tokens, rotate secrets, and audit GitHub Actions for unauthorized workflows.

headline: Unpatched Tailscale SSH Flaws Could Let a Hacked Device Reach Root on Other Servers
summary: Two flaws in Tailscale SSH allow a compromised device with port‑forwarding enabled to gain root access on reachable servers within the network.
whyItMatters: Lateral movement could lead to full network compromise.
recommendedAction: Apply the available patches and disable unnecessary port forwarding.

headline: PHP2Shell Exploitation Attempts Continue Amid Suspected N. Korea Global Scanning Activity
summary: Palo Alto Networks reports ongoing exploitation attempts of PHP2Shell flaws targeting a European government agency, amid broader scanning activity.
whyItMatters: Continued attacks indicate persistent threat actors targeting vulnerable PHP sites.
recommendedAction: Ensure all PHP systems are patched and increase monitoring for exploitation signatures.

headline: Malicious File in Downloads Folder Tries to Trick AI Coding Agent Into Installing Malware
summary: A malicious instruction file in a developer's Downloads folder attempted to persuade an AI coding agent to install a known‑malicious npm package, which was blocked by security monitoring.
whyItMatters: AI‑assisted development tools can be leveraged to deliver malware silently.
recommendedAction: Implement file integrity monitoring and restrict AI agent actions on untrusted inputs.

headline: Between alerts: What Attackers Do in the Spaces Ordinary Detection Misses
summary: The article discusses how SOCs struggle with alert overload and the need for network detection to connect alerts into a coherent intrusion timeline.
whyItMatters: The thin description requires human review to assess actionable insights.
recommendedAction: Have analysts review the detection workflow for gaps.

headline: Kali Linux 2026.3 released with 6 new tools, desktop updates
summary: Kali Linux 2026.3 adds six new hacking tools, desktop environment improvements, and refreshed build scripts.
whyItMatters: New tools may affect security testing and toolchains.
recommendedAction: Review the new tools for relevance to your environment.
